mission: build selective-risk curves for the confidence-emitting cascade stages (contact, stroke, ownership): sweep the answer/abstain confidence threshold and measure coverage vs silent-failure rate on replayable committed labeled data, grouped by independent session; identify HIGH->answer / INTERMEDIATE->partial / LOW->abstain operating points; report whether current thresholds sit on the efficient frontier. Measurement only — no production threshold changed.
method: new script datasets/experiments/wave-g/g20-selective-risk.ts reuses the unmodified committed-data replay harnesses (e02 contactGoldReplay for contact, e03 strokeHeuristicBench for stroke, D02 ownershipBench dual-frame loader for ownership). For each stage every evaluable unit becomes (sessionGroup, confidence|null, wrong|null); stage-internal abstentions stay in every coverage denominator. The threshold sweep visits every distinct observed confidence plus t=0 (the current production operating point: no downstream confidence gate exists at any stage) and records counts pooled and per session group, plus Pareto-frontier membership per point. Full curves: datasets/experiments/wave-g/g20-selective-risk-curves.json.

datasetScopeAndGrouping.contact: 10 target-owned gold contact events (wave-D contact sidecars) across 5 source sessions (dvids-944403 n=2, dvids-faead n=4, dvids-marne n=1, dvids-sasebo n=2, dvids-wgm n=1); LINUX-CPU, committed wave-a pose, ORACLE ball (gold frames, conf 0.9), no paddle track
datasetScopeAndGrouping.stroke: 18 evaluable stroke-gold labels across 3 source sessions (dvids-marne-2024 n=12, afn-sasebo-2025-06 n=5, dvids-warriorgames-2026 n=1); 0 answered rows excluded as unverifiable
datasetScopeAndGrouping.ownership: 38 dev dual frames across 5 source sessions (dvids-944403 n=14, afn-sasebo-2025-06 n=14, wm-tournament-2014 n=6, dvids-faead n=3, dvids-marne-2024 n=1); frames without committed pose (20) are incumbent-analog abstentions and stay in the denominator

holdoutStatement: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never read, listed, or referenced: the contact and stroke harnesses exclude them by construction and the ownership loader was called with includeHeldOut=false.

configuration.contactWrongness: silent-failure-v1 CONTACT_MARKER: |err| > 132ms, or 66 < |err| <= 132ms without ball/paddle confirmation (paddle unreachable on Linux)
configuration.strokeWrongness: confidently-wrong convention: L1 wrong OR L2 wrong among gold-verifiable components
configuration.ownershipScore: DERIVED selection margin 1 - dBest/dSecond over veto-surviving candidates for the incumbent S3 frame-level analog — production ownership emits NO confidence (finding); sole-survivor frames answer at margin 1 and cannot be ranked by it

operatingPointCandidates.caveat: candidates measured on this data only (n=10/18/38 units, 3-5 session groups) — NOT population guarantees and NOT production changes; validating them requires fresh labeled sessions

contact.INTERMEDIATE_partial: 0.488 <= conf < 0.78 (5 answered, 2 wrong — show with visible uncertainty)

ownership.HIGH_answer: margin >= 0.575 or sole veto survivor (12 answered, 1 wrong)
ownership.LOW_abstain: no veto survivor or no pose (21/38 frames)

findings: Current operating points (t=0, answer-everything-committed) sit on the Pareto frontier at every stage — but only as the maximum-coverage endpoint; each stage leaves a measurably safer high-confidence band unused.

Contact confidence is informative but shows one inversion: the mid-band (0.55-0.683) is dominated — both wrong markers carry conf 0.55-0.683 while the lowest emitted conf (0.488) answer is correct; the 0.55/0.7 confidence caps compress the scale (max emitted 0.86 under ORACLE ball).

Stroke is the riskiest answering stage measured: 2/5 committed labels wrong (risk 0.4 among answered) with only 5/18 coverage; conf >= 0.8 already cuts risk to 1/4 — consistent with f15's stroke label starvation.

Ownership emits no confidence in production — the veto is binary. The derived margin cleanly separates this data: all 10 sole-survivor picks are correct, and 4/7 margin-ranked contested picks below margin 0.717 include all 4 wrong picks; a margin >= 0.575 gate would have kept 12/17 answers with 1 wrong.

All curves are exact over these samples but small-n (10/18/38 units; wrong counts 2/2/4); per-session counts show errors concentrate in single sessions (contact: dvids-faead+dvids-sasebo; stroke: dvids-marne+wgm; ownership: all 4 wrong in dvids-944403), so pooled rates are optimistic about cross-session stability.
verdictRationale: The curves were measured honestly with counts at every point on replayable committed data and current thresholds were located on (the max-coverage end of) the efficient frontier, but n is too small (2-4 wrong answers per stage, errors concentrated in single sessions) to promote any operating point, and the ownership score is a derived margin because production emits no confidence there — so this is validated tooling plus provisional operating-point candidates, not a threshold recommendation.
